role: Carnap's infinite language system
notes: Carnap's infinite language system with denumerably many individual constants (1950 sec. 15A).

role: Carnap's finite language system with N individual constants
notes: Finite system with the first N individual constants.

role: limit m-function (D56-1)
notes: Limit m-function of D56-1; partial (defined only where the limit exists).

role: limit c-function (D56-2)
notes: Limit c-function of D56-2; partial.

role: number of Q-properties of a monadic system
notes: Number 2^pi of Q-properties (Carnap's kappa; k in the earlier Carnap chapter).

role: number of primitive predicates of a monadic system
notes: Number of primitive predicates (Carnap's pi; q in the earlier Carnap chapter). Local to this chapter.

role: finite monadic structure with named profile u and r unnamed elements per Q-property
notes: Finite monadic structure: named profile u plus exactly r unnamed elements per Q-property; introduced in thm:p15-w02b-p15-029-saturation and used in thm:p15-w02b-p15-029-monadic-limit.

role: set of named-profile words whose structures satisfy a sentence
notes: Set of named-profile words u with D_{r,u} satisfying i.

role: nongeneral reduction of a sentence with the same limit m-value
notes: Nongeneral reduction of sentence i with the same m*-limit.

role: number of structure descriptions of a finite system
notes: Carnap's number of structure descriptions in L_N (T35-1d, 110A (2)); r_N in the earlier chapter.

role: number of state descriptions isomorphic to a given state description
notes: Carnap's number of state descriptions isomorphic to Z_i, the number of disjuncts of Str_i (D27-1, 110A (2)).

role: Carnap's state description symbol
notes: Carnap's state description symbol (D18-1a).

role: Johnson's representative (predictive) function
notes: Predictive probability of category i as a function of its own count n_i and the sample size n (Zabell sec. 5).

role: positive continuum parameters of the Johnson-Carnap continuum
notes: Positive continuum parameters; alpha their sum.

role: Carnap's null confirmation
notes: Carnap's null confirmation c(j,t) (D57-1).

role: Carnap's instance confirmation of a law
notes: Carnap's instance confirmation of a law (110G (14)).

role: Carnap's qualified-instance confirmation of a law
notes: Carnap's qualified-instance confirmation (110G (15)).

role: violating kind of a law (M and not-M')
notes: M and not-M' in 110F-G; the law is L-equivalent to the absence of M_1.

role: positive kind of a law (M and M')
notes: M and M' in 110G.

role: width of the violating kind M_1
notes: Width of M_1 with 0 < w_1 < kappa.

role: width of the positive kind M_2
notes: Width of M_2.

role: sample count of the violating kind M_1
notes: Number of reported individuals that are M_1.

role: sample count of the positive kind M_2
notes: Number of reported individuals that are M_2.

role: ratio of the law's confirmation to its large-sample form
notes: Ratio of c*_N(l,e) to (s/N)^{w_1}.

role: Carnap's illustrative predictive family
notes: Carnap's illustrative family (s_1+m)/(s+2m) of sec. 47A; m=1 gives Laplace's rule.

role: Carnap's decision rule of high probability
notes: Name of a rule of secs. 50-51.

role: Carnap's decision rule of maximum probability
notes: Name of a rule of secs. 50-51.

role: Carnap's decision rule of use of estimates
notes: Name of a rule of secs. 50-51.

role: Carnap's decision rule of maximum estimated gain
notes: Name of a rule of secs. 50-51.

role: special form of the maximum-estimated-gain rule for an offer
notes: Accept if favorable, reject if unfavorable, either if neutral (sec. 50E).

role: Carnap's decision rule of maximum estimated utility
notes: Name of a rule of secs. 50-51.

role: present fortune of the agent
notes: Present fortune in money units (sec. 50E).

role: fortune after an action and an event
notes: Fortune if action j_i is performed and event h_k occurs (sec. 50E).

role: gain of an action under an event
notes: Gain f_ik - f_0; a loss is a negative gain.

role: estimate of the gain of an action
notes: Estimate sum_k q_ik g_ik of the gain of j_i.

role: confirmation of an event given the evidence and an action
notes: c(h_k, e and j_i).

role: total utility of fortune
notes: Total utility of fortune; Carnap writes f with a bar.

role: estimate of utility of an action
notes: Estimate of utility of action j_i.

role: money equivalent of the estimate of utility
notes: The gain whose utility is the estimate of utility of j_i (Bernoulli-Laplace device).

role: fortune plus the money equivalent of the estimate of utility
notes: f_0 plus the money equivalent of the estimate of utility.

role: subjectively neutral insurance premium
notes: Subjectively neutral insurance premium under Bernoulli's law.

role: indicator of the range of a sentence on states
notes: Indicator of the range of sentence j on states; used in the proof of thm:p15-w02b-p15-029-kemeny.

role: rising factorial
notes: Rising factorial x(x+1)...(x+r-1).

role: Carnap's in-correlation
notes: Carnap's in-correlation (D26-1); local to this chapter.

role: C-correlate of an expression
notes: Result of replacing each individual constant of the expression i by its C-correlate (D26-2); local to this chapter.

role: Carnap's bracket function
notes: Carnap's bracket function m!/(m-n)! (D40-3).

role: Carnap's structure description corresponding to a state description
notes: Carnap's structure description corresponding to Z_i (D27-1).

role: number of disjuncts of a statistical distribution
notes: Number of disjuncts of a statistical distribution (T92-1); local.

role: kind of an individual constant in a state under a division
notes: Kind of constant b in state z under a division; annex-local.
